fail_closed_rules: Model values must be finite and non-negative, with positive base_units.
Projections beyond max_units are rejected rather than extrapolated silently.
Synthetic projections are not empirical national measurements or production cost evidence.
A model revision or workload change requires a new content-addressed report.
non_claims: No provider pricing, national capacity, performance SLA or operational budget is inferred.
This contract does not replace hosted measurement or agent-panel qualification.
